AttributeDescription: The identifier originally assigned to a sample by collecting party or sample submitter. Values may not be unique in this database.
Latitude coordinate of sample site, reported in decimal degrees; converted, if necessary, to WGS84 datum.
Longitude coordinate of sample site, reported in decimal degrees; converted, if necessary, to WGS84 datum.
Radius (in meters) of positional-uncertainty envelope of the sample location.
The specific rock name assigned by the collector based on initial field observations. Queried if uncertain.
Geologic age or age range for a rock sample. Queried if uncertain.
Laboratory codes for the analytical methods used to analyze the sample. Multiple laboratory codes separated by semicolons.

Arsenic, determined by ICP-AES analysis of 9-12 base metal elements, following sample decomposition by four-acid digestion (ME-4ACD81). Method detection range: 5-10,000 ppm As. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.

Chromium, determined by 30-38 element ICP-MS, lithium metaborate fusion (ME-MS81). Method detection range: 10-10,000 ppm Cr. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.

Copper, determined by 30-38 element ICP-MS, lithium metaborate fusion (ME-MS81) or by ICP-AES analysis of 9-12 base metal elements, following sample decomposition by four-acid digestion (ME-4ACD81). ME-MS81 method detection range: 5-10,000 ppm Cu. ME-4ACD81 method detection range: 1-10,000 ppm Cu.Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.

Nickel, determined by 30-38 element ICP-MS, lithium metaborate fusion (ME-MS81) or by ICP-AES analysis of 9-12 base metal elements, following sample decomposition by four-acid digestion (ME-4ACD81). ME-MS81 method detection range: 5-10,000 ppm Ni. ME-4ACD81 method detection range: 1-10,000 ppm Ni. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.

Lead, determined by 30-38 element ICP-MS, lithium metaborate fusion (ME-MS81) or by ICP-AES analysis of 9-12 base metal elements, following sample decomposition by four-acid digestion (ME-4ACD81). ME-MS81 method detection range: 5-10,000 ppm Pb. ME-4ACD81 method detection range: 1-10,000 ppm Pb. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.

Zinc, determined by 30-38 element ICP-MS, lithium metaborate fusion (ME-MS81) or by ICP-AES analysis of 9-12 base metal elements, following sample decomposition by four-acid digestion (ME-4ACD81). ME-MS81 method detection range: 5-10,000 ppm Zn. ME-4ACD81 method detection range: 2-10,000 ppm Zn. Concentrations less than the Lower Detection Limit (<LDL) are identified with a negative sign (-LDL). A blank or NULL value indicates that no data are available.
